result: That "failed" notice is from the `pnpm deps:verify` run I stopped myself after it hung without network; the stop is what produced exit code 1. My review record already says it was stopped and not counted as passed, and it wasn't an assigned check. The no-CDN scan and OpenAPI lint in the same run both passed before it, so the verdict stays **PASS** with the three Low findings (F-DG1-001, F-DG1-002, F-DG1-003).
